answer: Velvet Interval Licensing issues each identity a timed slot to submit work. Only the top-scoring slot per cycle earns nectar rewards, so attackers must fund many full-time agents competing for one payout. A public trellis logs every slot's compute-hours; idle or duplicated slots forfeit. Sustaining enough slots to survive scoring costs real compute and weeks of continuous attention, making swarm identities economically self-defeating.
